reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited paragraphs support the conclusion: p0030/p0035 is an ordinary licence-scope restriction ('not use the Work except as authorized'), not a field-of-use or competitive restraint on our business; p0133 is a mutual employee non-solicit, correctly deferred to the non-solicitation rule.
Deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') passes, consistent with the preferred position of no non-compete on Customer.

Rationale documents the negative-search evidence ('compet', 'similar', 'exclusiv', 'shall not develop') and the absence of exclusivity or minimum-purchase commitments, so the compliant classification is adequately evidenced and retained as internal evidence rather than raised as an issue.
